theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U m) (y : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), 0 < ρ → ball y ρ ⊆ U → y ∈ M → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → IsOrientation m M ξ → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball y ρ → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y ρ → T ω = k * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → HasMassDensity T y (k.natAbs : ℝ)
